lifecyclePhases.label: Specify
lifecyclePhases.summary: State the alignment target or constitutional rule the system is supposed to serve — what counts as success before construction or certification arguments apply.

lifecyclePhases.label: Construct
lifecyclePhases.summary: Build (or show buildable) a system that robustly tracks that target. Distinct from identifying what the target is or certifying that evidence licenses tracking.

lifecyclePhases.label: Identify
lifecyclePhases.summary: Measure and identify the real control locus, value structure, and access boundaries — what is actually in the loop, not what the specification claims.

lifecyclePhases.label: Certify
lifecyclePhases.summary: Oversight, audits, and safety-case evidence license that the deployed system meets claimed properties — including resistance to hidden capability and checklist gaming.

lifecyclePhases.label: Preserve
lifecyclePhases.summary: Maintain correction integrity, value/bearer transport, and basin stability under pressure, substrate change, successor handoffs, and long-run selection.

specifyConstructInstances.correspondence: What remains of CEV after factorizing volition, referent, and correction onto MB2–MB4 is a ConstitutionalRule (constituency + extrapolation + aggregation). There is no associated constructive procedure in the MIRI writeup comparable to RLAIF or a GSAI builder — Lean records claimsExplicitBuilder = false. ConstructionCrux for this target stays open; retired MB8 is not a builder.

Bai et al. state principles (the constitution) and train with RLAIF so the model tracks those principles. The specify instance is the principle set (operator constituency, iterated/extrapolative feedback, multi-value aggregation). The construction bet is the RLAIF stack — an explicit builder, hence claimsExplicitBuilder = true. That flag is not ConstructionCrux: Lean’s fin_claimed_builder_without_realization separates catalog claims from realization.

GSAI’s specify instance is an explicit world-modelled specification (openWorldCoverage = true), not CEV-style extrapolation (extrapolation = false, so the AlignmentTarget does not demand a correction-channel slot via that flag). The construction bet is the constructivist safety-case / spec-relative builder. Completeness of the spec is a cousin of MB9 conservativity, not the same crux; the builder is a cousin of ConstructionCrux, not a discharge.

Appendix C maps rights/duties and constitutional balancing onto value bundles, and procurement/insurance/licensing onto selection. The specify instance is an institutional ConstitutionalRule (institutional = true; not extrapolative volition). The construction bet is socio-technical: certified vendors, audit packs, and deployment gates that are supposed to realize those constraints. Mapping is illustrative — Lean flags the family, it does not prove isomorphism with ML constitutions.
